# MATLAB Simulink Energy Lab

> Open MATLAB and Simulink reference models for lithium-ion battery equivalent circuits, SOC estimation with extended Kalman filters, battery thermal management, buck converters, and grid-following/grid-forming BESS control. The repository pairs reduced-order educational models with deterministic checks and explicit limitations. Bundled benchmarks and parameters are synthetic or illustrative unless the nearest source says otherwise.

Canonical repository: <https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab>

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/README.md): Project purpose, quick start, complete model table, requirements, validation evidence, scope, release, citation, and license.
- [Model selection guide](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/docs/model-selection-guide.md): Choose the smallest battery, SOC, thermal, converter, or BESS model for an engineering question.
- [Technical FAQ](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/FAQ.md): Direct answers about dependencies, model coverage, evidence, synthetic data, limitations, reproduction, citation, and licensing.
- [Examples index](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/README.md): Every example, key source files, run commands, dependencies, and expected output.

## Validation and claim boundaries

- [Validation results](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/docs/validation-results.md): Reproduction commands, exact hosted CI evidence, expected numeric output, and environment.
- [Validation manifest](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/docs/validation-manifest.md): Per-commit machine-readable validation provenance and limitations.
- [Scope and limitations](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/README.md#scope-and-limitations): What the reduced-order checks do and do not establish.

## Battery and SOC models

- [First-order battery RC model](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/battery-rc-model/README.md): Nonlinear OCV, one polarization state, SOC, voltage, and duty-cycle accounting.
- [Two-RC battery model and parameter identification](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/battery-2rc-model/README.md): Fast and slow polarization plus synthetic calibration and held-out validation.
- [Two-RC identification tutorial](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/docs/two-rc-battery-parameter-identification.md): Reproducible fitting workflow and interpretation boundaries.
- [Battery SOC EKF](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/battery-soc-ekf/README.md): Joseph-form EKF and prescribed current-sensor-bias sensitivity.
- [Hysteresis-aware SOC EKF](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/battery-soc-hysteresis-ekf/README.md): Three-state estimator compared with a two-state baseline on a synthetic reversal case.

## Thermal-management models

- [Lumped electro-thermal cell](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/battery-thermal-model/README.md): Irreversible and reversible heat, cooling, resistance feedback, and limit exposure.
- [Six-cell liquid-cooling network](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/battery-module-cooling-network/README.md): Serial coolant warming, cell-to-cell conduction, and module temperature spread.
- [Pouch-cell finite-volume thermal gradient](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/pouch-cell-thermal-gradient/README.md): One-dimensional conservative finite volumes, asymmetric cooling, and grid convergence.

## Power electronics and BESS

- [Switching closed-loop buck converter](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/converter-switching-closed-loop-model/README.md): Period-sampled control, explicit ideal PWM, loss separation, and fixed-temperature sensitivity.
- [BESS DC-link and SOC reserve](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/bess-dc-reserve-model/README.md): Requested, delivered, curtailed, and battery power under illustrative reserve constraints.
- [Unified grid-following and grid-forming BESS control](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/examples/bess-unified-control/README.md): Averaged control, transitions, synchronization, limits, faults, recovery, requirements, and traceability.
- [Grid-forming BESS walkthrough](https://github.com/mohammadrezwankhan/matlab-simulink-energy-lab/blob/main/docs/grid-forming-bess-control.md): Executable scenario guide with explicit non-certification boundaries.
